summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_26. FIXED: when a signed-in user loads a product URL directly (goto, refresh or new tab), the landing page and the '/?p=<key>' hub panel now render correctly (13/13). Clicking hub cards and product tabs works signed in and signed out (20/20). The hub header button, login pages, counsellor pages, admin page, logo sub 'Wellbeing', title and hero image all work. NEW CRITICAL REGRESSION: the student /dashboard no longer switches to the student's own brand. After browsing another product, /dashboard shows that product's name and colours, even after a full refresh. Cause: StudentHome uses HomeLayout, not AppHeader, so nothing calls setBrand(user.programme) any more now that the auth.jsx effect has been removed.

ui_bugs.issue: fe-aarav browses /?p=mindedge, then clicks 'Go to my dashboard': /dashboard shows brand-name 'MindEdge' and data-theme ocean. After browsing /mindmellow, a direct goto /dashboard and a refresh both show 'MindMellow' in lavender. me-riya after browsing /focusedge: /dashboard shows 'FocusEdge' in indigo. The student's dashboard takes on whichever product was last viewed. This is stored in localStorage eq_brand, so it stays after a refresh.

issues: The header logo/brand still follows the last browsed product (known since iteration_26, minor).

rca of the issue: Before this change, auth.jsx's effect forced the brand for every signed-in page. Now only AppHeader (components/Shell.jsx) re-applies user.programme. The /dashboard route renders StudentHome, which uses components/home/HomeLayout.jsx with its own header (Logo, ThemeToggle, NotificationBell) and never mounts AppHeader. ThemeProvider's initialBrand() for /dashboard falls back to localStorage eq_brand, which the landing or hub page just wrote, so the brand stays wrong. Counsellor, admin, check-in and report pages use AppHeader, so they are fine. To reproduce: sign in as fe-aarav, open /mindmellow, then open /dashboard. It shows MindMellow in lavender. Fix: in HomeLayout add `const { setBrand } = useTheme(); useEffect(() => { if (user?.programme) setBrand(user.programme); }, [user?.programme]);`. A more robust option is to do this once in App.js Guard for all signed-in, non-admin routes. Also check B.key !== user.programme, so the page does not briefly show the wrong brand.
action_items: CRITICAL: re-apply the user's programme brand on the student /dashboard (HomeLayout.jsx, or centrally in the App.js Guard for non-admin roles). After the fix, retest that fe-aarav's /dashboard shows FocusEdge in indigo after browsing other products: via the hub button, a direct goto and a refresh. Also retest me-riya (MindEdge, ocean).
Optional: the admin header brand follows the last browsed product.
critical_code_review_comments: Keeping the brand on signed-in pages depends on each page shell remembering to call setBrand. HomeLayout was missed. Putting it in Guard (App.js) covers every signed-in route in one place.
Landing.jsx and BiglypHome.jsx now use [brand, B.key] / [sel, B.key] deps with a guard that re-applies when the brand differs. This is correct and fixes the iteration_26 blank page.
